description: Stage 1 vendor-identity contract set. v1.3.0 opened 2026-05-23 for feature 022-ocr-semantic-quality-gate (Clarifications Q14 + security-clarify Q-SEC-2/B + Q-SEC-7/B). The version increment lands in stacked PRs: PR 1/7 (foundation) registers the new semantic_table_truth.json sidecar schema and bumps contract_set_version; PR 2/7 (US1 sidecar validator) amends folder.schema.json to list semantic_table_truth.json as optional; PR 4/7 (US3 report surface) adds the semantic_table_quality object + document_pass_fail.semantic_table_quality_passed to evaluation_document.schema.json, and the top-level semantic_table_quality_metrics namespace + semantic_document_statuses array to evaluation_run_summary.schema.json. At foundation-PR landing, evaluation_document / evaluation_run_summary / folder schemas are byte-identical to v1.2.0; the additive amendments land in their respective downstream PRs. v1.0.0, v1.1.0, and v1.2.0 artifacts remain major-compatible; newly generated semantic-aware artifacts should be stamped 1.3.0 once the full stack has merged.
